title: Electrical Work Job Safety Analysis
description: Free Electrical Work Job Safety Analysis template for construction you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers project information, job steps & hazard analysis.
html:
Project Information

JSA ID: ELEC-__________ DATE: ______________ TIME: ______________

PROJECT: ______________ LOCATION: ______________ WORK TYPE: ☐ New ☐ Repair ☐ Maintenance

ELECTRICIAN: ______________ VOLTAGE: ______________ V QUALIFIED WORKER: ☐ Yes ☐ No

Job Steps & Hazard Analysis

JOB STEPHAZARDS IDENTIFIEDPOTENTIAL CONSEQUENCERISK RATING (L x S)CONTROL MEASURES
1. Hazard Assessment & Planning-Live parts
-Hidden wiring
-Capacitors
-Multiple sources		-Electrocution
-Arc flash
-Shock
-Explosion		25 (VERY HIGH)-Identify all energy sources
-Test for voltage before work
-Review one-line diagrams
-Determine incident energy
-Calculate arc flash boundary
2. Lockout/ Tagout (LOTO)-Failure to isolate
-Improper lock placement
-Multiple workers		-Unexpected startup
-Electrocution
-Energy release		25 (VERY HIGH)-Shut down equipment
-Apply personal lock and tag
-Try to restart after LOTO
-Test for absence of voltage
-Verify zero energy state
-Each worker applies own lock
3. Voltage Testing & Verification-Improper meter use
-Meter failure
-Wrong range
-Insulated gloves damaged		-False reading
-Contact live parts
-Arc flash		20 (VERY HIGH)-Use properly rated meter (CAT III/IV)
-Test meter on known source
-Verify absence of voltage
-Test phase-to-phase and phase-to-ground
-Retest meter after verification
-Use hot sticks if needed
4. Work on De- energized Equipment-Contact with live parts
-Stored energy
-Induced voltage		-Electrocution
-Arc flash
-Burns
-Shock		20 (VERY HIGH)-Use rubber insulating gloves
-Use insulating blankets/mats
-Ground all phases
-Short circuit nearby conductors
-Treat as live until verified
5. Work Near Live Parts (Limited Approach)-Arc flash
-Reach into restricted space
-Inadvertent movement		-Severe burns
-Electrocution
-Death		25 (VERY HIGH)-Establish approach boundaries
-Use rubber gloves and blankets
-Wear arc flash suit
-Use insulated tools
-Maintain minimum approach distances
-Work with qualified assistant
6. Conduit & Cable Handling-Sharp edges
-Dust/debris
-Heavy pulls
-Tripping hazards		-Lacerations
-Eye injury
-Back strain
-Fall		12 (HIGH)-Deburr cut ends
-Wear leather gloves
-Safety glasses
-Team lifting
-Keep pathways clear
7. Panel & Junction Box Work-Crowded panels
-Loose connections
-Wrong wire gauge		-Arc flash
-Short circuit
-Overheating
-Fire		16 (HIGH)-Keep panels clear
-Proper torque connections
-Maintain wire bending space
-Use knockouts
-Fill unused openings
-Label circuits
8. Restoration & Testing-Missing grounds
-Tools left
-Re-energization errors		-Arc flash
-Shock
-Short circuit
-Equipment damage		12 (HIGH)-Remove grounds and shorts
-Inspect work area
-Account for all tools
-Remove LOTO tags
-Energize systematically
-Test for proper operation
